housing.summary: Basel offers relatively more affordable rents than Zurich or Geneva. Average 1-BR city-centre apartments run ~CHF 1,699/month per Numbeo (Aug 2026). Swiss law caps the rental deposit at 3 months' rent. Main portals: homegate.ch, comparis.ch, immoscout24.ch.

banking.summary: To open a bank account in Switzerland, residents need a valid passport or ID, proof of Swiss residence registration (Anmeldebestätigung), and a residence/work permit (non-EU). Main banks in Basel: UBS and Basler Kantonalbank (BKB). Raiffeisen branches are also available. PostFinance serves the whole country.
required_docs: Employer letter or salary slip (sometimes required)

schools.summary: Basel's international community, driven by pharmaceutical companies (Novartis, Roche), supports several international schools. International School Basel (ISB) offers IB and American curricula. The Minerva School offers a Swiss Matura. The German-French border region also offers French lycée options.

legal_admin.summary: Newcomers must register at the Einwohnerdienste Basel-Stadt within 14 days of arrival. EU/EFTA nationals register for permit B or L at the Amt für Migration Basel-Stadt. Non-EU nationals need a residence permit from the cantonal authority before or upon arrival. Authority: sem.admin.ch.
legal_admin.registration_step: Anmeldung at Einwohnerkontrolle within 14 days; residence permit from cantonal migration authority

tax_finance.summary: The AHV-Nummer (OASI number) serves as the Swiss social insurance and tax reference number, assigned by the SVA Basel-Stadt (cantonal compensation office) or employer. Basel-Stadt levies cantonal income and wealth taxes; cross-border commuters from Germany/France may have specific tax treaties applying.

transport.summary: Basel's public transport is operated by BVB (Basler Verkehrs-Betriebe) and BLT (Baselland Transport), part of the TNW (Tarifverbund Nordwestschweiz) network. A monthly city zone pass costs approximately CHF 86 per Numbeo data. EU/EFTA driving licences are exchangeable within 12 months at the Motorfahrzeugkontrolle Basel-Stadt without a driving test. Mandatory Krankenversicherung must be arranged within 3 months of arrival; regulated by BAG/OFSP.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: EU/EFTA licences exchangeable within 12 months at Motorfahrzeugkontrolle Basel-Stadt (mfk.bs.ch); non-EU licences generally require a theory and/or practical test
transport.healthcare_registration: Mandatory basic health insurance (Krankenversicherung/KVG) must be arranged within 3 months of arrival; choose a licensed insurer at bag.admin.ch
